thesis.whyThisStock: Normal ranked scout selection combines positive older momentum and unusual relative resilience in a weak healthcare sector; new full audited accounts allow company-level challenge.
thesis.whyNow: Confirmed October18 pullback lies near586support and four days before a material AGM. The rejected cost-adjusted geometry and unsettled accounting require waiting.
thesis.mispricingMechanism: Sustained sales/cash growth and credible remediation could support a rerating; no quantified undervaluation is established at the current price.
thesis.bullCase: FY profit552.54m grows24.52%, CFO410.94m is positive, balance/cash bridges reconcile and a named majority supports clear control identification. Current close remains aboveSMA50 in a falling sector.
thesis.bearCase: Gross margin falls, ECL/impairment adequacy remains qualified, idle-capacity losses grow, slow inventory/old balances need cure, governance committees unfinished and current T1costRR is only about1.00 at0.5% costs.
thesis.alternativeExplanation: Strength can reflect old momentum, expected distribution or concentrated float rather than improved sustainable returns; market decline need not be a company-specific judgment.
thesis.pricedIn: The price already rose materially over months and the proposed dividend is small against price; no consensus target or isolated event-study is available.
thesis.invalidation: Confirmed break below586support and576.99 diagnostic stop would defeat this measured rebound; adverse cash/credit/cure evidence could defeat the business thesis independently. No stop order approved.
thesis.whatWouldChangeMyMind: Read AGM resolutions/company cure, verify later actions and source a defensible normalized forecast or accept explicit value uncertainty; require confirmed bullish zone candle/RV20>=1 and independent priced-plan2:1costgate.
thesis.whyBetterThanAlternative: No superiority overADCI established. ADCI also has qualified CAO issues and different capital/profit-allocation economics; compare verified normalized margins and collections before allocation.
thesis.disagreementResolution: Positive cash generation supports business viability; qualified accounting is economic uncertainty rather than an automatic ban. The current trade fails the existing cost gate regardless of financial interpretation.
thesis.evidenceQuality: Full issuer-linked accounts and actual auditor/register/AGM scans inspected, dates/custody retained; generic earlier archive financial label corrected toESG.
thesis.uncertainties: No sourced forward three-case revenue/margin/reinvestment/cost-of-capital assumptions or normalized ECL/impairment adjustment; no DCF/fairvalue or calibrated probability.
thesis.status: Analytical research; final guarded approval remains separate
